summary: Luda Technology Group Limited filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, announcing a press release disclosing a sales blanket agreement worth about RMB1.6 billion with Shandong Yulong Petrochemical Company, Limited to supply pipeline fittings for the Yulong Island Refining and Chemical Integration Project (Phase One). This is a routine commercial contract announcement, not a corporate special situation. No securities transactions, strategic alternatives, or capital structure changes are involved. The agreement is an ordinary supply contract that supports operations and financial performance, with no special-situation relevance. The filing maps to a standard foreign private issuer current report.
